brief:
The occupied West Bank city of Tulkarm received freed detainee Nadim Abu al-Rub on Monday after Israeli authorities released him following nearly two years of detention, Shehab Wire reported. Residents and family members gathered to welcome him as he arrived in the city, marking the end of an extended period in Israeli custody.

Camera footage captured emotional scenes during Abu al-Rub's arrival, documenting his reunion with those who had awaited his release. Observers noted his severely weakened physical condition following his time behind bars, underscoring the toll of his prolonged imprisonment.
